<!-- ::: {style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));grid-gap: 1em;"} -->

:::: {.grid data-masonry='{ "itemSelector": ".grid-item", "gutter": 0 }'}

```{r}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
#| message: false
img_meta <- readr::read_csv("photos/image-meta.csv")
img_files <- img_meta$img_path
img_captions <- img_meta$alt_text
cat(
  glue::glue("
    :::{{.grid-item}}
    ![{img_captions}](photos/{img_files}){{group='my-gallery'}}
    :::"),
  sep = "\n"
)
```
